topics.name: Relation Identity
topics.purpose: Define canonical relations as first-class explicit semantic identities connecting exact endpoint identities with declared role, direction and semantics rather than inferred adjacency.

semantics.identity_rule: Every machine-significant relation has an explicit stable identity.
semantics.endpoint_rule: Source and target endpoints resolve by exact canonical identity.
semantics.role_rule: Endpoint roles/names are explicit where machine-significant.
semantics.type_rule: Relation kind/semantics are explicit and separate from containment, ownership, authority and dependency unless the relation specifically represents one of those dimensions.
semantics.instance_rule: Relation definition and individual relation instance/use are distinguishable where needed.
semantics.no_inference_rule: Shared Topic, same schema, UI adjacency or naming similarity never creates a relation.

invariants.rule: Schema, field and relation identities are explicit and stable; instance data, presentation labels and physical storage never define canonical schema semantics.

hard_gates.condition: relation silently used as ownership/authority without declaration

references.purpose: Relation remains distinct from other structural dimensions.
